elements.element: Trigger: obligations arise on expiry or termination of the Agreement
elements.evidence: "Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement, Harpoon shall"

elements.element: Assistance available for up to 6 months
Return in a standard machine-readable format
Return within 30 days, running from expiry or termination (not a request)
Deletion of the data after return
elements.evidence: "(c) thereafter delete such Customer Data from its systems"
"certify such deletion in writing to AbbVie"
"transition assistance for up to six (6) months" (exceeds 90 days)
"within 30 days after expiry or termination, return all Customer Data"

reasons: The inserted Section 12.6.6 captures every preferred element: 6-month transition assistance at then-current rates, 30-day return in a standard machine-readable format measured from expiry or termination, and deletion plus written certification thereafter.
The insertion is a concise single provision addressing an absent obligation; existing Sections 9.7 and 12.10.2 and all unrelated commercial terms are untouched.

Intent concern: "Customer Data" is not a defined term in this Agreement (which uses "Information" and "Confidential Information"), so the new clause introduces an undefined term and an uncertain scope of the return/deletion duty. Recommend tying it to "data and Information generated by or on behalf of AbbVie" or adding a definition.

Note also that clause (c) deletion of "such Customer Data" may sit awkwardly with the retention carve-outs in Section 9.7 (archival/back-up and one retained copy); a cross-reference would avoid an apparent conflict.
